fields.description: Program Description 1. Introduction to Chinese Language Program Editor Notes: The course is taught in Chinese and provides different levels of study. The program is divided into Elementary Level (A, B), Intermediate Level (C, D), and Advanced Level (E). In total, there are 18-week courses a term. Study Place: OUC Fushan Campus, No.23 Eastern HongKong Road. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: This program offers 8 main courses for international students. Intensive Reading Spoken Chinese Reading Listening Comprehension Chinese Culture Chinese Writing Reading of Chinese Newspaper Reading of Chinese Periodicals Contents for Chinese culture Week Topic Week Topic 1 Introduction: Dos and Don’ts 7 Great Thinkers and Philosophers 2 Chinese Cuisine 8 Chinese Education 3 Chinese Languages 9 Chinese Religion 4 New China and Influencing Figures 10 Chinese Literature and Art 5 Chinese Customs 11 Chinese Festivals 6 Chinese Dynasties and Historical Events 12 Chinese Medicine and Massage, Qigong 3. Sample Curriculum Editor Notes: This curriculum is for reference only. Time and Duration Editor Notes: Here is the time arrangement and application time. 4.1 Time of Entrance Spring Semester: First Monday of March Fall Semester: First Monday of September 4.2 Duration of Study 1/2-2 years 4.3 Time of Application Spring Semester: The End of February Fall Semester: The End of August 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: Ocean University of China is a comprehensive university under the direct jurisdiction of the State Ministry of Education. There are over 20,000 registered students at Ocean University of China , including 4,500 Master's and Doctoral students and over 500 international students. Among the 2,300 faculty members there are many nationally and internationally recognized experts and scholars, 8 academicians of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and 5 academicians of Chinese Academy of Engineering. Ocean University of China (hereinafter referred to as OUC) is located in Qingdao, a renowned summer resort and an attractive historic tourist city of scenic beauty and temperate climate. Learn More about Ocean University of China. 6. International Education Center Editor Notes: OUC is now offering a large range of programs to international students, including some tailor-made programs. Each year more than 1300 international students from over 50 countries pursue their Certificate/Diploma/Bachelor's degree/Master's degree/Ph.D in our university. Our programs, especially known for their high standards of teaching and considerate services have been attractive to students from all over the world. Various cooperation has been set up with world-famous universities from different countries, such as Germany, USA, U.K. Russia, Japan, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia etc. 7. Campus Life Editor Notes: Various activities will be organized usually and students lead a rich and colorful life. (Tai Chi Show) ​ (Chinese Contest)

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents in time. * 1. 2-inch photo * 2. Scanned copy of the first page of passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included(Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Passport must be an ordinary passport and be valid for at least six months. Applicants currently residing in China must include a copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.) * 3. Certificate of Non-criminal Record It must be issued by your local police station with official stamp. If not in English or Chinese, it should be translated into English or Chinese. * 4. Certificate/diploma of highest education Graduation certificates should be notarized; If not in English, graduation certificates should be translated into English. * 5. Academic transcript of highest education Transcripts should be notarized; If not in English, transcripts should be translated into English. 6. Bank statement Bank statement of 20,000 RMB is required for applicants who apply for one academic year and above * 7. Resume 1. The Education Background must start from Senior High School until now. 2. If you have worked or once worked, please fill out the Work Experience, and provide the Job Letter (certificate of employment). 3. If you have not worked after graduating from school, fill in the duration and "no working" Note: If not in English or Chinese, it should be translated into English or Chinese. If you can not find a translation organization, please contact CUCAS. You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Physical examination record for foreigner(only valid for 6 months) Please take it to hospital to have a checkup with all items, including personal information, photo, checking date, doctors' suggestion and signature. 9. Work certificate (for those with work experience) 10. Supporting Documents: Certificate of Good Conduct Provided by your current/previous school/company in Chinese/English to improve your success rate. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
